dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**RED-HOT PERFORMANCES LIGHT UP THE MLB**

In a thrilling slate of games, several standout performances stole the show. In Washington, Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds with two hits, including a home run, while Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz also contributed to the offense. Will Dion earned the win for the Nationals. Meanwhile, in Boston, Eli White went 3-for-4 with an RBI for the Athletics, who edged out the Red Sox 4-3 behind Elvis Alvarado's winning performance. 

In a one-sided victory, the New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1, with Luis Robert Jr. crushing a home run and driving in four runs. Sean Manaea shone on the mound with seven strikeouts and one earned run. Elsewhere, Kyle Schwarber went deep twice and drove in four runs for the Phillies in their 7-6 win over the Blue Jays.

In other notable performances, Pete Alonso blasted two home runs and drove in four runs for the Orioles in their 10-5 victory over the Rangers. Eduardo Rodriguez pitched a complete game with nine strikeouts for the Diamondbacks in their 4-2 win over the Dodgers.
